Item: How should rain be managed at the lid?
Prompt / specification: A flush seam can admit wind-driven water even when the top looks flat and tight. Options: Use slope, overhang, drip edges, and a drained ventilated inner boundary | Use a fitted weather-resistant cover over a ventilated box | Caulk the lid permanently around its frame

Item: How is the heavy lid controlled?
Prompt / specification: Wind and changing leverage can exceed a support that felt adequate near closed position. Options: Match paired supports and positive latches to measured lid mass and geometry | Divide the lid into smaller independently controlled panels | Use a loose prop stick

Item: Should wet items be placed directly inside?
Prompt / specification: Water brought in on toys, hoses, or tools can remain below dry cushions and against the floor. Options: Separate wet and dry zones with removable drained components | Require wet items to dry before storage | Store all gear in one sealed compartment
